Committee: Finance and Taxation Education
Sponsor: Orr
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 02/14/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 175 as introduced allows funds in the Education Trust Fund Advancement and Technology Fund to be used for capital outlay expenses. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Arthur Orr, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation Education
